sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心思想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但查明身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The police listened on as Craig Folbig expressed his belief that maybe he had killed their four children.
sentences.zh: 警方在旁聆听时，克雷格·福尔比格表示，他认为也许是他杀死了他们的四个孩子。

sentences.en: Kathleen asked why he would think such a thing.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳问他为什么会这么想。

sentences.en: Craig told her to think about it.
sentences.zh: 克雷格让她好好想想。

sentences.en: Every time they'd had a child, it had driven a wedge between them.
sentences.zh: 他们每生一个孩子，夫妻间的隔阂就加深一层。

sentences.en: And the best way he could get Kathleen's attention was to get rid of the kids.
sentences.zh: 而他能引起凯瑟琳注意的最好办法，就是除掉这些孩子。

sentences.en: He presented a scenario in which he waited until Kathleen went to sleep in the middle of the night and then got up to kill the children.
sentences.zh: 他提出了一个设想：他等到凯瑟琳半夜熟睡后起床，杀害了孩子们。

sentences.en: With Laura, he waited until Kathleen went outside and then sneaked in through the front door without her ever knowing he was there.
sentences.zh: 至于劳拉，他等到凯瑟琳出门后，从前门溜了进去，而她对此一无所知。

sentences.en: Who had anything to gain out of them not being around?
sentences.zh: “谁能从他们的死中获益？”

sentences.en: Craig asked, before answering.
sentences.zh: 克雷格问完后，自己给出了答案。

sentences.en: Me.
Kathleen told Craig that he was being ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳告诉克雷格，他简直是在胡说八道。

sentences.en: Craig clarified that he was suggesting a hypothetical but that such a case against him was just as feasible as the one the police were building against Kathleen.
sentences.zh: 克雷格解释说，他只是在做一个假设，但这种针对他的指控，和警方正在针对凯瑟琳构建的指控一样“可行”。

sentences.en: Referring to Detective Bernie Ryan, Craig said, all I'm trying to show you is the futility of the bullshit he's going on.
sentences.zh: 克雷格提到伯尼·瑞安警探时说：“我只是想让你看看他那些废话有多荒谬。”

sentences.en: Kathleen said she was scared and told Craig never to mention such a thing again.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳说她很害怕，并告诉克雷格永远不要再提这种事。

sentences.en: It's bad enough Detective Ryan is going for one of us, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“瑞安警探已经盯上我们其中一人了，这已经够糟糕的了。”

sentences.en: Craig told Kathleen it was Detective Ryan who had first planted the idea in his head that the children had been murdered, adding,
sentences.zh: 克雷格告诉凯瑟琳，正是瑞安警探最先在他脑海中植入了孩子们是被谋杀的想法，并补充道：

sentences.en: I don't want him going after you for something you didn't do.
sentences.zh: “我不想让他因为你没做过的事而找你麻烦。”

sentences.en: I know you didn't do it.
sentences.zh: “我知道你没做过。”

sentences.en: Like you know I didn't do it.
sentences.zh: “就像你知道我没做过一样。”

sentences.en: But Craig's support for Kathleen was too late.
sentences.zh: 但克雷格对凯瑟琳的支持来得太晚了。

sentences.en: The police had already started to compile evidence that suggested to them that Craig's reported suspicions were right all along.
sentences.zh: 警方已经开始收集证据，这些证据让他们认为克雷格最初的怀疑一直都是对的。

sentences.en: Detectives working the Fulbig case put together a preliminary brief of evidence.
sentences.zh: 负责福尔比格案的侦探们整理了一份初步证据摘要。

sentences.en: It contained the medical histories of the four Fulbig children as well as transcripts of Kathleen's police interview and copies of her diaries.
sentences.zh: 其中包含了四个福尔比格孩子的病史，以及凯瑟琳的警方访谈笔录和她的日记副本。

sentences.en: Then they got to work seeking expert opinions.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们开始寻求专家的意见。

sentences.en: It quickly became clear that the majority of experts strictly adhered to Meadows Law.
sentences.zh: 很快人们发现，大多数专家都严格遵循“梅多斯法则”。

sentences.en: When it came to the unexplained death of an infant, one was a tragedy, two were suspicious, and three most likely pointed to murder.
sentences.zh: 该法则认为，当婴儿出现不明原因死亡时，一次是悲剧，两次是可疑，三次则极有可能指向谋杀。

sentences.en: After reviewing the case, one police psychologist concluded, If natural causes are eliminated, then, in my opinion,
sentences.zh: 在审查该案后，一位警方的心理学家得出结论：“如果排除了自然原因，那么依我之见，

sentences.en: Kathleen Fulbig became angry and frustrated with her children's crying and need for constant attention to a point where it overwhelmed her,
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·福尔比格对孩子们的哭闹和对持续关注的需求感到愤怒和沮丧，以至于无法承受，

sentences.en: and she lost control and consciously ended the lives of each child.
sentences.zh: 于是她失去了控制，有意识地结束了每个孩子的生命。”

sentences.en: The brief of evidence was also sent to Dr Susan Beale,
sentences.zh: 这份证据摘要也被送交给了苏珊·比尔医生，

sentences.en: a paediatrician from Adelaide's Women's and Children's Hospital who had studied SIDS for more than 30 years and was considered one of Australia's leading experts in the field.
sentences.zh: 她是阿德莱德妇女儿童医院的一名儿科医生，研究婴儿猝死综合征（SIDS）超过30年，被认为是澳大利亚该领域顶尖的专家之一。

sentences.en: As far as Dr Beale was aware, there had never been more than three SIDS-related deaths in a single family anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 据比尔医生所知，世界上从未有任何一个家庭发生过超过三起与SIDS相关的死亡事件。

sentences.en: The only such occurrences had later been revealed to be homicide.
sentences.zh: 唯一类似的案例后来都被证实是凶杀案。

sentences.en: She also agreed with Dr Alan Carla that the deaths of Caleb and Sarah Fulbig shouldn't have been classified as SIDS.
sentences.zh: 她也同意艾伦·卡拉医生的观点，即凯莱布和莎拉·福尔比格的死亡不应被归类为SIDS。

sentences.en: Not only weren't they in the right age bracket, but they had also both been found sleeping on their backs.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅年龄不符合，而且两人被发现时都是仰卧的。

sentences.en: 80% of SIDS deaths occur when the infant is lying on their stomach.
sentences.zh: 80%的SIDS死亡发生在婴儿俯卧时。

sentences.en: In Patrick's case, Dr Beale didn't believe that epilepsy had caused his first apparent life-threatening event, or ALTI.
sentences.zh: 关于帕特里克，比尔医生不认为癫痫导致了他第一次明显的危及生命的事件（ALTI）。

sentences.en: In babies as young as Patrick, epileptic fits were typically caused by another disease which would be detectable in an EEG brain scan or at autopsy.
sentences.zh: 在像帕特里克这么大的婴儿中，癫痫发作通常是由其他疾病引起的，这些疾病在脑电图扫描或尸检中是可以检测出来的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it would be rare for the first epileptic fit to cause the level of brain damage that Patrick had sustained.
sentences.zh: 此外，第一次癫痫发作就造成帕特里克所受的那种程度的脑损伤是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: As for Laura, Dr Beale didn't think the myocarditis played a role in her unexplained death either.
sentences.zh: 至于劳拉，比尔医生也不认为心肌炎在她不明原因的死亡中起到了作用。

sentences.en: Like Professor Hilton, she believed that Meadows Law must be applied to the Fulbig children and that it was most likely that all four of them had been suffocated,
sentences.zh: 和希尔顿教授一样，她认为梅多斯法则必须适用于福尔比格家的孩子，而且他们四个极有可能都是被闷死的，

sentences.en: telling Detective Ryan,
sentences.zh: 她告诉瑞安警探：

sentences.en: I have no hesitation in saying I believe that all four children were murdered by their mother.
sentences.zh: “我毫不怀疑地说，我相信这四个孩子都是被他们的母亲谋杀的。”

sentences.en: Detective Ryan flew to the United States to meet with Dr Janice Oppoven, a paediatric forensic pathologist who specialised in mothers who kill their children.
sentences.zh: 瑞安警探飞往美国，会见了儿科法医病理学家珍妮丝·奥波文医生，她专门研究杀害子女的母亲。

sentences.en: Years of research had taught her that the number one cause of deaths in infants living in developed countries wasn't disease,
sentences.zh: 多年的研究告诉她，发达国家婴儿死亡的首要原因不是疾病，

sentences.en: but physical injury typically inflicted by a caregiver.
sentences.zh: 而是通常由照看者造成的身体伤害。

sentences.en: After reviewing the Fulbig case file and examining tissue samples taken from the four children, Dr Oppoven ruled that none of their deaths could be attributed to SIDS.
sentences.zh: 在审查了福尔比格案卷并检查了从四个孩子身上提取的组织样本后，奥波文医生断定他们的死亡均不能归因于SIDS。

sentences.en: She stated that SIDS is not a hereditary problem and that, quote,
sentences.zh: 她指出SIDS不是遗传性问题，并称，引用原话：

sentences.en: As the children had all been growing normally and their autopsies identified no sign of disease,
sentences.zh: “由于孩子们一直发育正常，且尸检未发现任何疾病迹象，

sentences.en: Dr Oppoven believed that all four of them had been suffocated by the last person to see them alive, Kathleen Fulbig.
sentences.zh: 奥波文医生认为他们四个都是被最后一个见到他们活着的人——凯瑟琳·福尔比格——闷死的。”

sentences.en: Dr Alan Kala submitted his final autopsy report for Laura, listing her death as undetermined and stating it was possible that all four children were deliberately smothered.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·卡拉医生提交了劳拉的最终尸检报告，将她的死因列为“未确定”，并表示四个孩子都有可能是被蓄意闷死的。

sentences.en: He pointed out that it would be relatively easy for an adult to smother an infant or small child using their hand, a soft toy or a pillow without leaving a trace.
sentences.zh: 他指出，成年人使用手、软玩具或枕头闷死婴儿或幼儿，且不留下痕迹是相对容易的。

sentences.en: Dr Kala's report concluded,
sentences.zh: 卡拉医生的报告总结道：

sentences.en: Opinion was also sought from UK paediatric pathologist and SIDS specialist Professor Peter Berry,
sentences.zh: 警方还寻求了英国儿科病理学家和SIDS专家彼得·贝里教授的意见，

sentences.en: who said he was not aware of any other case where four infants from the same family had died of unexplained natural causes.
sentences.zh: 他表示，他不知道还有其他任何案例，同一个家庭的四个婴儿都死于不明原因的自然因素。

sentences.en: He pointed out that Caleb's autopsy had revealed signs of hemocytorin, or repeated bleeding, in his lungs.
sentences.zh: 他指出，凯莱布的尸检显示他的肺部有含铁血黄素沉着，即反复出血的迹象。

sentences.en: Combined with Kathleen's diary entry from the night Caleb died in which she enthusiastically wrote,
sentences.zh: 结合凯瑟琳在凯莱布去世当晚日记中热情洋溢写下的：

sentences.en: Finally Asleep, Professor Berry believed it was possible that Caleb had not only been smothered to death,
sentences.zh: “终于睡着了”，贝里教授认为凯莱布不仅可能被闷死，

sentences.en: but also smothered on a previous occasion from which he was able to recover.
sentences.zh: 而且在此前可能还有过一次被闷住但幸存下来的经历。

sentences.en: He also agreed that it was unlikely that Patrick's ulti was caused by an epileptic seizure.
sentences.zh: 他也同意帕特里克的ALTI不太可能是由癫痫发作引起的。

sentences.en: Instead, he thought Patrick might have been suffocated to the point of brain damage.
sentences.zh: 相反，他认为帕特里克可能被闷到导致了脑损伤。

sentences.en: As for Sarah, if he viewed her death in isolation, Professor Berry agreed he could put it down to SIDS.
sentences.zh: 至于莎拉，如果单独看她的死亡，贝里教授承认他可以将其归因于SIDS。

sentences.en: But knowing what he knew about her siblings and the alleged tension between Kathleen and Sarah on the night that she died, he had his misgivings.
sentences.zh: 但结合他所了解的关于她兄弟姐妹的情况，以及凯瑟琳和莎拉在去世当晚所谓的紧张关系，他心存疑虑。

sentences.en: In regards to Laura, he said the level of myocarditis in her heart was extensive enough to cause sudden death,
sentences.zh: 关于劳拉，他说她心脏中的心肌炎程度足以导致猝死，

sentences.en: but there wasn't damage to her actual heart muscles as one would expect if myocarditis was responsible.
sentences.zh: 但她的心肌本身并没有出现如果是由心肌炎引起时所预期的损伤。

sentences.en: He pointed out that myocarditis was also commonly found in individuals who died from other causes, such as traffic accidents or suffocation.
sentences.zh: 他指出，心肌炎也常见于死于其他原因（如交通事故或窒息）的人身上。

sentences.en: Professor Berry concluded,
sentences.zh: 贝里教授总结道：

sentences.en: I am unable to rule out that Caleb, Patrick, Sarah and possibly Laura Folbig were suffocated by the person who found them lifeless.
sentences.zh: “我无法排除凯莱布、帕特里克、莎拉，甚至可能是劳拉·福尔比格是被发现他们尸体的人闷死的可能性。”

sentences.en: And I believe that it is probable that this was the case.
sentences.zh: “而且我相信这很可能就是事实。”

sentences.en: It took the investigation team months to compile their brief of evidence.
sentences.zh: 调查组花了几个月的时间才整理出这份证据摘要。

sentences.en: By late 2000, nearly two years after Laura's death, Detective Ryan finally felt confident enough to submit the preliminary brief to the Director of Public Prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 到2000年底，距离劳拉去世已近两年，瑞安警探终于有信心将初步摘要提交给公诉署（DPP）。

sentences.en: The DPP would decide if there was enough to charge Kathleen Folbig with murdering her children.
sentences.zh: DPP将决定是否有足够的证据以谋杀罪起诉凯瑟琳·福尔比格。

sentences.en: To his disappointment, the answer was no.
sentences.zh: 令他失望的是，答案是否定的。

sentences.en: The DPP felt there wasn't sufficient evidence to secure a conviction and recommended the case be handed over to the coroner for a full coronial inquiry instead.
sentences.zh: DPP认为没有足够的证据定罪，建议将案件移交给验尸官进行全面的死因研讯。

sentences.en: Detective Ryan was undeterred.
sentences.zh: 瑞安警探并没有气馁。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, the decision to proceed with charges lay with him, and after devoting years of his life to the case, he was convinced that Kathleen was guilty.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，决定是否起诉的权力在他手中，在为这个案子投入了多年心血后，他确信凯瑟琳有罪。

sentences.en: Determined to get justice for the innocent and defenceless Folbig siblings and put a serial killer behind bars,
sentences.zh: 为了给无辜且手无寸铁的福尔比格兄妹伸张正义，并将连环杀手绳之以法，

sentences.en: Detective Ryan discussed the case with the Deputy State Coroner and a Crown Prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 瑞安警探与副州验尸官及皇家检察官讨论了此案。

sentences.en: They agreed there was enough evidence to at least charge Kathleen with Laura's murder.
sentences.zh: 他们一致认为，至少有足够的证据以谋杀劳拉的罪名起诉凯瑟琳。

sentences.en: Detective Ryan was convinced that if he could just get Craig back on his side, there would be enough to proceed with all four murder charges.
sentences.zh: 瑞安警探确信，如果能让克雷格重新站在他这边，就有足够的证据推进全部四项谋杀指控。

sentences.en: And he had an idea of how he could do it.
sentences.zh: 他想到了一个办法。

sentences.en: While the investigation had continued slowly behind the scenes,
sentences.zh: 在调查在幕后缓慢进行的同时，

sentences.en: Craig and Kathleen split up for good in mid-2000.
sentences.zh: 克雷格和凯瑟琳在2000年中期彻底分手了。

sentences.en: Kathleen was already living with her new boyfriend, a builder she'd met at the gym.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳当时已经和她的新男友住在一起，那是一个她在健身房认识的建筑工人。

sentences.en: If there was any chance of convincing Craig to withdraw his support for Kathleen and admit that he'd lied when retracting his original police statement, the time was now.
sentences.zh: 如果还有机会说服克雷格撤回对凯瑟琳的支持，并承认他在撤回最初的警方陈述时撒了谎，现在就是时候了。

sentences.en: On April 19, 2001, Detective Ryan visited Craig at work and placed him under arrest for hindering the investigation into his children's deaths.
sentences.zh: 2001年4月19日，瑞安警探在克雷格工作时拜访了他，并以妨碍儿童死亡调查为由将其逮捕。

sentences.en: Faced with this, Craig admitted he was telling the truth when he initially went to the police to voice his suspicions about Kathleen.
sentences.zh: 面对这种情况，克雷格承认他最初向警方表达对凯瑟琳的怀疑时说的是实话。

sentences.en: He stood by the story that he'd woken up about half an hour before Sarah's dead body was discovered to find that she and Kathleen weren't in their beds.
sentences.zh: 他坚持自己的说法：在发现莎拉的尸体前约半小时，他醒来发现她和凯瑟琳都不在床上。

sentences.en: Craig said that Kathleen's stories about the children simply didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 克雷格说，凯瑟琳关于孩子们的说辞根本站不住脚。

sentences.en: Referring to his last interaction with Laura, he said,
sentences.zh: 提到他与劳拉的最后一次互动，他说：

sentences.en: How could I kiss a perfectly gorgeous little baby goodbye and half an hour later be confronted with that child dead?
sentences.zh: “我怎么可能吻别一个完美可爱的婴儿，半小时后就面对她死亡的事实？”

sentences.en: In the year and a half since flip-flopping on his allegations against Kathleen,
sentences.zh: 在对凯瑟琳的指控反复横跳的一年半里，

sentences.en: Craig had felt deeply ashamed of himself.
sentences.zh: 克雷格感到非常羞愧。

sentences.en: I've lived with the shame of coming and changing that story, he said.
sentences.zh: “我一直带着改变证词的羞耻感生活，”他说。

sentences.en: I've felt that I couldn't protect those children in life, and I certainly didn't protect them in death.
sentences.zh: “我觉得我没能在生前保护好那些孩子，死后也肯定没能保护他们。”

sentences.en: With Craig back on their side and agreeing to testify against Kathleen, the detectives were finally ready to make their move.
sentences.zh: 随着克雷格重新站在他们一边并同意出庭指证凯瑟琳，侦探们终于准备好采取行动了。

sentences.en: That afternoon, they went to Kathleen Fulbig's flat and knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，他们来到凯瑟琳·福尔比格的公寓并敲了门。

sentences.en: When she answered, Detective Ryan looked her in the eyes and said the words he'd been working for years to bring to fruition.
sentences.zh: 当她开门时，瑞安警探直视她的眼睛，说出了他多年来一直致力于实现的话。

sentences.en: Kathy, you are under arrest for murdering your four children.
sentences.zh: “凯西，你因谋杀你的四个孩子而被捕。”

sentences.en: Do you understand?
sentences.zh: “你明白吗？”

sentences.en: 33-year-old Kathleen Fulbig was charged with four counts of murder and remanded without bail.
sentences.zh: 33岁的凯瑟琳·福尔比格被控四项谋杀罪，不得保释。

sentences.en: The media quickly picked up on the story and the news sent shockwaves through the local community, particularly for Kathleen's new boyfriend, Tony.
sentences.zh: 媒体迅速跟进了这个故事，新闻在当地社区引起了轰动，尤其是对凯瑟琳的新男友托尼来说。

sentences.en: He'd fallen head over heels in love with Kathleen and envisioned them getting married and having a family together.
sentences.zh: 他深深地爱上了凯瑟琳，并憧憬着他们结婚并组建家庭。

sentences.en: He couldn't fathom that the warm and loving woman he knew could be responsible for such a horrific allegation.
sentences.zh: 他无法想象他所认识的那个温暖而充满爱心的女人，竟然会与如此可怕的指控有关。

sentences.en: The press published some of the most damning expert opinions from the police statement of facts, including Dr Ophoven's belief that the odds of all four Fulbig children
sentences.zh: 媒体发布了警方事实陈述中最具破坏性的专家意见，包括奥波文医生认为四个福尔比格孩子

sentences.en: dying of unexplained natural causes was one in a trillion.
sentences.zh: 死于不明原因自然因素的概率是万亿分之一。

sentences.en: Accompanied by the excerpt from Kathleen's diary in which she compared herself to her murderous father,
sentences.zh: 再加上凯瑟琳日记中将自己与她那杀人犯父亲相提并论的摘录，

sentences.en: it didn't take long before she was considered guilty in the court of public opinion.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，她在舆论法庭上就被视为有罪了。

sentences.en: If the court of law also found Kathleen guilty, it would make her one of the most prolific female serial killers in Australian history.
sentences.zh: 如果法院也判决凯瑟琳有罪，她将成为澳大利亚历史上最多产的女性连环杀手之一。

sentences.en: But the press had to be careful.
sentences.zh: 但媒体必须谨慎。

sentences.en: Kathleen's case was quickly likened to that of Lindy Chamberlain, a Queensland mother who was accused of killing her newborn daughter Azaria in 1980,
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的案件很快被比作林迪·张伯伦案，这是一位昆士兰母亲，她被指控在1980年杀害了她刚出生的女儿阿扎里亚，

sentences.en: as covered in episode 136 of Case File.
sentences.zh: 正如《Casefile》第136集所报道的那样。

sentences.en: Lindy steadfastly maintained that Azaria had been taken by a dingo.
sentences.zh: 林迪坚定地坚持阿扎里亚是被野狗叼走的。

sentences.en: However, the media painted her in such a negative light that it played a significant role in what turned out to be Lindy's wrongful conviction
sentences.zh: 然而，媒体将她描绘得如此负面，以至于在后来被证明是林迪的冤案中起到了重要作用，

sentences.en: and one of the worst miscarriages of justice in Australian legal history.
sentences.zh: 这也成为了澳大利亚法律史上最严重的司法不公之一。

sentences.en: A month after her arrest, Kathleen applied for bail again.
sentences.zh: 被捕一个月后，凯瑟琳再次申请保释。

sentences.en: The prosecution still had a long road ahead to prepare their case for trial, and she wanted to live with Tony and resume her job as a waitress while she prepared her defence.
sentences.zh: 检方在准备审判方面还有很长的路要走，她想在准备辩护期间与托尼住在一起，并恢复她服务员的工作。

sentences.en: The judge agreed to release Kathleen on $8,000 bail, citing the fact that she had no other children and therefore didn't present a threat to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 法官同意以8000美元保释凯瑟琳，理由是她没有其他孩子，因此不会对其他人构成威胁。

sentences.en: Tony helped secure her bond, convinced that Kathleen was innocent and that once this whole fiasco was behind them, they could move on with building a life together.
sentences.zh: 托尼帮助她筹集了保释金，坚信凯瑟琳是无辜的，一旦这场闹剧过去，他们就能继续共同生活。

sentences.en: While Kathleen was out on bail, the months passed as the prosecution team continued building their case against her.
sentences.zh: 在凯瑟琳保释期间，几个月过去了，检方团队继续构建针对她的案件。

sentences.en: In addition to the expert opinions and circumstantial evidence provided by her diary entries and witness statements,
sentences.zh: 除了专家意见以及由她的日记条目和证人陈述提供的间接证据外，

sentences.en: they established a ten-point list of what's known as coincidence evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们建立了一份所谓的“巧合证据”十点清单。

sentences.en: This is a type of circumstantial evidence that shows that two or more similar events occurring in similar circumstances are too improbable to have happened by chance.
sentences.zh: 这是一种间接证据，表明在相似情况下发生的两个或多个类似事件，其发生的概率极低，不可能是巧合。

sentences.en: The list highlighted that all four of the Fulbig children died suddenly and unexpectedly while at home during a period of sleep.
sentences.zh: 清单强调，所有四个福尔比格孩子都是在睡眠期间于家中突然且意外死亡的。

sentences.en: Prior to each death, or in Patrick's case his ulti, each child had appeared perfectly normal and healthy.
sentences.zh: 在每次死亡之前，或者在帕特里克的案例中是他的ALTI之前，每个孩子看起来都非常正常和健康。

sentences.en: All of the deaths occurred while Kathleen was the only adult at home or awake.
sentences.zh: 所有的死亡都发生在凯瑟琳是家中唯一成年人或唯一清醒的人时。

sentences.en: She was the one to discover each of them during what she claimed to be a normal check of their wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 她是在她所谓的正常检查孩子健康状况时发现每个孩子的。

sentences.en: Three of these checks just so happened to have occurred on her way back from the toilet and all literally within minutes of the child stopping breathing.
sentences.zh: 其中三次检查恰好发生在从洗手间回来的路上，而且都在孩子停止呼吸后的几分钟内。

sentences.en: In each incident except for Laura's death, Kathleen didn't offer any assistance.
sentences.zh: 在除了劳拉死亡之外的每起事件中，凯瑟琳都没有提供任何帮助。

sentences.en: She didn't even lift the children out of their beds.
sentences.zh: 她甚至没有把孩子们从床上抱起来。

sentences.en: Kathleen was bolstered by support from Tony and a group of faithful friends, many of whom had known her since childhood.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳得到了托尼和一群忠实朋友的支持，他们中许多人从童年起就认识她。

sentences.en: They didn't believe the allegations against her for a second.
sentences.zh: 他们一秒钟都不相信针对她的指控。

sentences.en: Among them was Kathleen's foster sister Lee, her trustworthy protector.
sentences.zh: 其中就有凯瑟琳的寄养姐妹李，她值得信赖的保护者。

sentences.en: Or so she thought.
sentences.zh: 或者她自己是这么认为的。

sentences.en: While Lee had fiercely defended her sister since the beginning, in the years since Laura's death, she'd had numerous conversations with Detective Bernie Ryan.
sentences.zh: 虽然李从一开始就极力维护她的姐妹，但在劳拉去世后的几年里，她与伯尼·瑞安警探进行了多次交谈。

sentences.en: Over time, her opinion had started to change.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，她的观点开始改变。

sentences.en: Reflecting on events, Lee realised there had been instances where Kathleen's behaviour was questionable.
sentences.zh: 回顾往事，李意识到凯瑟琳的行为确实存在令人质疑的情况。

sentences.en: In January 1998, when Laura was five months old and still using the apnea monitor,
sentences.zh: 1998年1月，当劳拉五个月大且仍在使用呼吸暂停监护仪时，

sentences.en: Lee and her family had gone to stay with the Fulbigs.
sentences.zh: 李和她的家人去福尔比格家做客。

sentences.en: One day, Laura was napping inside while everyone else was out in the pool.
sentences.zh: 一天，劳拉在屋里小睡，其他人都在泳池边。

sentences.en: Lee felt a migraine coming on and went inside to lie down.
sentences.zh: 李感到偏头痛发作，便进屋躺下。

sentences.en: To her great surprise, the apnea alarm went off, twice.
sentences.zh: 令她大吃一惊的是，呼吸暂停警报响了，响了两次。

sentences.en: Despite its loud, high-pitched noise, neither Kathleen or Craig responded to it.
sentences.zh: 尽管警报声尖锐刺耳，但凯瑟琳和克雷格都没有做出反应。

sentences.en: When Lee mentioned it to Kathleen later on, she seemed indifferent and simply said she hadn't heard it.
sentences.zh: 后来李向凯瑟琳提起这件事时，她似乎并不在意，只是说她没听说过。

sentences.en: Another time, when Laura was 17 months old, the Fulbigs went to Melbourne to stay with Lee and her family for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，劳拉17个月大时，福尔比格一家去墨尔本和李及其家人一起过圣诞节。

sentences.en: One day, while feeding Laura in her highchair, Kathleen was in a bad mood, complaining that she wasn't getting enough sleep.
sentences.zh: 有一天，凯瑟琳在给坐在高脚椅上的劳拉喂食时，心情很不好，抱怨自己睡眠不足。

sentences.en: When Laura refused to eat, Kathleen lost her temper and yanked the toddler out of the highchair by her arm.
sentences.zh: 当劳拉拒绝进食时，凯瑟琳大发雷霆，一把抓住这名幼儿的手臂，将她从高脚椅上拽了下来。

sentences.en: Lee had been alarmed.
sentences.zh: 李感到很震惊。

sentences.en: Not only did she think it was totally uncalled for, she had never seen this side of her sister's personality.
sentences.zh: 她不仅认为这种行为完全没必要，而且从未见过她姐姐性格中如此暴戾的一面。

sentences.en: She caught another glimpse of it on Christmas Eve, when Laura was too excited to sleep and Kathleen once again lost her temper and overreacted.
sentences.zh: 平安夜那天，她又目睹了这一幕，当时劳拉因为太兴奋而睡不着觉，凯瑟琳再次大发雷霆，反应过度。

sentences.en: Lee had also been alarmed when Kathleen told her that she'd once disciplined her puppy by kicking him down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 当凯瑟琳告诉李她曾通过把小狗踢下楼梯来管教它时，李也感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: Eventually, like Craig Folbig before her, Lee turned against Kathleen and contacted the police to change her statement.
sentences.zh: 最终，就像之前的克雷格·福尔比格一样，李站到了凯瑟琳的对立面，并联系警方更改了她的证词。

sentences.en: But Kathleen was none the wiser.
sentences.zh: 但凯瑟琳对此一无所知。

sentences.en: The two sisters remained in regular contact, with Lee agreeing to record their phone conversations and act as a witness for the prosecution while feigning ongoing support.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩保持着频繁的联系，李同意录下她们的通话，并假装继续支持凯瑟琳，实则担任检方的证人。

sentences.en: On Friday, May 24, 2002, more than a year after her arrest, Kathleen Folbig officially entered her plea of not guilty to all four murder charges.
sentences.zh: 2002年5月24日星期五，在被捕一年多后，凯瑟琳·福尔比格正式对四项谋杀指控表示不认罪。

sentences.en: She was committed to stand trial in the Supreme Court the following year.
sentences.zh: 她被移交至最高法院，将于次年接受审判。

sentences.en: Six months later, she was hit with an additional charge of maliciously inflicting grievous bodily harm in relation to Patrick Zolti.
sentences.zh: 六个月后，她又被追加了一项关于帕特里克·佐尔蒂的恶意造成严重身体伤害的指控。

sentences.en: Kathleen pleaded not guilty to this charge as well.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳对这项指控也表示不认罪。

sentences.en: It had been a challenging time for Kathleen's defence team, who were so convinced of her innocence,
sentences.zh: 这对凯瑟琳的辩护团队来说是一段充满挑战的时期，他们坚信她是无辜的，

sentences.en: that New South Wales' senior public defender Peter Zara had agreed to work the case pro bono.
sentences.zh: 以至于新南威尔士州的高级公设辩护律师彼得·扎拉同意免费代理此案。

sentences.en: The defence applied to have the cases for each of the Folbig children tried separately,
sentences.zh: 辩方申请将福尔比格家每个孩子的案件分开审理，

sentences.en: so that the jury could judge each of their deaths as a standalone case without knowing about their siblings.
sentences.zh: 这样陪审团在不知道其他孩子死亡情况的前提下，可以将每起死亡案件作为独立案件进行评判。

sentences.en: The application was denied on the grounds that when considered separately, there could be plausible natural causes for the death of each child.
sentences.zh: 该申请被驳回，理由是如果分开考虑，每个孩子的死亡都可能有合理的自然原因。

sentences.en: It was only when all four cases were examined together and the coincidence evidence was considered that the case for murder became apparent.
sentences.zh: 只有当四起案件放在一起审视并考虑巧合证据时，谋杀案的论点才变得显而易见。

sentences.en: But there was one piece of good news for the defence.
sentences.zh: 但对辩方来说，有一个好消息。

sentences.en: Something huge had happened in the time since Kathleen's arreSt.
sentences.zh: 自凯瑟琳被捕以来，发生了一件大事。

sentences.en: In England back in 1996, an 11-week-old boy named Christopher Clark had died unexpectedly in his sleep.
sentences.zh: 早在1996年的英国，一个名叫克里斯托弗·克拉克的11周大男婴在睡梦中意外死亡。

sentences.en: Two years later, his eight-week-old brother, Harry, suffered the same fate.
sentences.zh: 两年后，他8周大的弟弟哈里遭遇了同样的命运。

sentences.en: Both cases were initially recorded as SIDS, but the boy's mother, Sally Clark, became suspected of having smothered them.
sentences.zh: 两起案件最初都被记录为婴儿猝死综合征（SIDS），但男孩的母亲萨莉·克拉克开始被怀疑闷死了他们。

sentences.en: She was ultimately charged with murdering both of her children.
sentences.zh: 她最终被控谋杀了自己的两个孩子。

sentences.en: Renowned paediatrician Professor Roy Meadow testified at Sally's trial, presenting his theory that one sudden infant death in a family is a tragedy,
sentences.zh: 著名儿科医生罗伊·梅多教授在萨莉的审判中作证，提出了他的理论：一个家庭中出现一起婴儿猝死是悲剧，

sentences.en: two is suspicious, and three is murder unless proven otherwise.
sentences.zh: 两起是可疑，三起就是谋杀，除非另有证明。

sentences.en: Meadow said that the odds of both Christopher and Harry, who had been born into an affluent, non-smoking family, dying from SIDS, was one in 73 million.
sentences.zh: 梅多说，克里斯托弗和哈里出生在一个富裕、不吸烟的家庭，两人都死于婴儿猝死综合征的概率是七千三百万分之一。

sentences.en: According to Professor Meadow, two SIDS deaths in a single family was so rare, he would only expect it to occur once every 100 years.
sentences.zh: 据梅多教授称，同一个家庭发生两起婴儿猝死综合征的情况非常罕见，他预计每100年才会发生一次。

sentences.en: He said there was a better chance of someone placing an 80-to-1 outsider bet on the Grand National Horse Race and winning, four years in a row.
sentences.zh: 他说，一个人在英国国家障碍赛马中押注80比1的冷门马并连续四年获胜的几率，都要比这大得多。

sentences.en: Based in part on Professor Meadow's evidence,
sentences.zh: 部分基于梅多教授的证据，

sentences.en: Sally Clark was found guilty and sentenced to life in prison, which she unsuccessfully appealed in 2002.
sentences.zh: 萨莉·克拉克被判有罪并被判处终身监禁，她在2002年的上诉未获成功。

sentences.en: On her second appeal in early 2003, it emerged that during the autopsy for Sally's younger son, Harry, he had tested positive for a bacterial infection that could have been fatal.
sentences.zh: 在2003年初的第二次上诉中，有证据显示在萨莉的小儿子哈里的尸检过程中，他被检测出一种可能致命的细菌感染呈阳性。

sentences.en: The pathologist who performed Harry's autopsy didn't disclose his findings to either of the legal teams and it therefore hadn't been presented at Sally's trial.
sentences.zh: 负责哈里尸检的病理学家没有向任何一方律师团队披露他的发现，因此这些证据没有在萨莉的审判中呈现。

sentences.en: Furthermore, serious questions had been raised about the statistics put forward by Professor Meadow, with the Royal Statistical Society saying his figures were false.
sentences.zh: 此外，梅多教授提出的统计数据也受到了严重质疑，英国皇家统计学会称他的数据是错误的。

sentences.en: A professor of mathematics had reviewed SIDS statistics against homicide statistics and concluded that although instances of double SIDS are very rare, double murder is even rarer.
sentences.zh: 一位数学教授将婴儿猝死综合征的统计数据与凶杀案统计数据进行了对比，得出的结论是，尽管双重婴儿猝死综合征非常罕见，但双重谋杀更为罕见。

sentences.en: Statistically speaking, it was actually twice as likely for two children from one family to die from SIDS than it was for a mother to kill two of her babies.
sentences.zh: 从统计学上讲，一个家庭中两个孩子死于婴儿猝死综合征的可能性，实际上是母亲杀死两个婴儿可能性的两倍。

sentences.en: The appellate judges reviewing Sally's case found that Christopher and Harry's deaths should not have been tried together.
sentences.zh: 负责审查萨莉案件的上诉法官认为，克里斯托弗和哈里的死亡案不应该合并审理。

sentences.en: They also found that the statistical information put forward by Professor Meadow was clearly inadmissible and should never have been allowed in evidence as it misled the jury.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现，梅多教授提出的统计信息显然是不可采信的，绝不应该作为证据被允许使用，因为它误导了陪审团。

sentences.en: Sally Clark was subsequently released from prison in January 2003 and had her conviction overturned.
sentences.zh: 萨莉·克拉克随后于2003年1月获释，其定罪被推翻。

sentences.en: With just months until Kathleen's trial was scheduled to begin, this was positive news for her legal team.
sentences.zh: 距离凯瑟琳的审判开始仅剩几个月，这对她的法律团队来说是个好消息。

sentences.en: If Professor Meadow's statistics were unreliable, then Dr Opphoven's scathing opinion that there was a one in a trillion chance of four children from the same family dying of SIDS
sentences.zh: 如果梅多教授的统计数据不可靠，那么奥普霍芬医生关于同一个家庭四个孩子死于婴儿猝死综合征的几率是万亿分之一的尖锐观点，

sentences.en: was essentially meaningless.
sentences.zh: 本质上就毫无意义了。

sentences.en: The judge ruled Dr Opphoven's conclusion inadmissible at Kathleen's trial, despite it having already been widely published in the media.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定奥普霍芬医生的结论在凯瑟琳的审判中不可采信，尽管该结论此前已在媒体上被广泛报道。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the defence asked for extra time while they sought further information from overseas about a potential correlation that was starting to emerge
sentences.zh: 与此同时，辩方要求延长时间，以便他们从海外寻求更多信息，了解一种因萨莉·克拉克上诉而开始显现的潜在关联。

sentences.en: as a result of Sally Clark's appeal.
sentences.zh: （接上句）

sentences.en: It had been hypothesised that particular genetic mutations might lead to an increased risk of SIDS or even cause SIDS.
sentences.zh: 据推测，特定的基因突变可能会导致婴儿猝死综合征的风险增加，甚至直接导致婴儿猝死综合征。

sentences.en: The judge adjourned the case temporarily to give the defence time for further testing, but with no further developments emerging, it was time for Kathleen to face the music.
sentences.zh: 法官暂时休庭，给辩方时间进行进一步测试，但由于没有新的进展出现，凯瑟琳不得不面对现实。

sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: By the time Kathleen Folbig's murder trial commenced in the New South Wales Supreme Court on Tuesday April 1, 2003,
sentences.zh: 当凯瑟琳·福尔比格的谋杀案审判于2003年4月1日星期二在新南威尔士州最高法院开始时，

sentences.en: Craig Folbig was engaged to another woman and surrounded by loved ones and supporters.
sentences.zh: 克雷格·福尔比格已经与另一名女性订婚，身边围绕着亲人和支持者。

sentences.en: Their now 35-year-old Kathleen, on the other hand, was essentially alone.
sentences.zh: 而他们现在35岁的凯瑟琳，本质上是孤身一人。

sentences.en: Her foster mother, with whom she had a strained relationship, was siding with Craig, despite the two not getting along in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 她的养母与她关系紧张，尽管两人过去并不和睦，但现在却站在了克雷格一边。

sentences.en: Her foster sister had turned on her and one of her closest friends was unable to travel to Sydney to testify on her behalf due to health concerns about her own pregnancy.

sentences.en: of Forensic Medicine who was widely considered to be Australia's leading forensic pathologiSt.
sentences.zh: 被广泛认为是澳大利亚首席法医病理学家的斯蒂芬·科德纳教授进行了独立审查。

sentences.en: After spending an entire year on the case,
sentences.zh: 在花费整整一年时间研究此案后，

sentences.en: Professor Cordner was bewildered by the fact that it had never been explicitly stated during Kathleen's trial that there had been no physical evidence to support the possibility
sentences.zh: 科德纳教授对一个事实感到困惑：在凯瑟琳的审判中，从未明确说明过没有任何物理证据支持孩子们

sentences.en: that the children had been smothered or killed by any means.
sentences.zh: 是被闷死或以任何方式杀害的可能性。

sentences.en: This was particularly poignant in Laura's case.
sentences.zh: 这一点在劳拉的案件中尤为突出。

sentences.en: As Laura was old enough to have fully erupted teeth, if she had been smothered, Professor Cordner would have expected to see tooth marks on the inside of her mouth.
sentences.zh: 由于劳拉已经长出了完整的牙齿，如果她被闷死，科德纳教授本应预期在她的口腔内看到牙印。

sentences.en: Instead, there were absolutely no signs of asphyxia or compressions to her face and no evidence of a struggle expected in a toddler of that age.
sentences.zh: 相反，她的脸上完全没有窒息或受压的迹象，也没有那个年龄段幼儿在挣扎时预期的任何证据。

sentences.en: However, the level of myocarditis was significant enough that in Professor Cordner's view, most forensic pathologists would feel comfortable to rule it the cause of Laura's death.
sentences.zh: 然而，心肌炎的程度相当严重，在科德纳教授看来，大多数法医病理学家都会认为将其定为劳拉的死因是合理的。

sentences.en: He also found it completely reasonable to attribute Caleb and Sarah's deaths to SIDS.
sentences.zh: 他也认为将凯莱布和莎拉的死归因于婴儿猝死综合征（SIDS）是完全合理的。

sentences.en: While he couldn't determine what had caused Patrick's ulti, he was confident that his eventual death was, quote, an unsurprising consequence of the state
sentences.zh: 虽然他无法确定帕特里克的最终死因，但他确信其最终死亡是，引用他的话，在该事件后他所处状态下一种并不令人意外的后果，

sentences.en: he was left in following the ulti.
sentences.zh: 即他在该事件后所处的状态。

sentences.en: Professor Cordner put his findings in a 125-page report that was peer-reviewed and supported by a number of international experts who further debunked the theory
sentences.zh: 科德纳教授将他的发现整理成了一份125页的报告，该报告经过了同行评审，并得到了多位国际专家的支持，他们进一步驳斥了

sentences.en: that two or more infant deaths should be treated as homicides.
sentences.zh: 两名或两名以上婴儿死亡应被视为他杀的理论。

sentences.en: They agreed with Cordner when he concluded, quote,
sentences.zh: 他们赞同科德纳的结论，引用如下：

sentences.en: There is no forensic pathology evidence to suggest that the Fulbig children were deliberately smothered or killed.
sentences.zh: 没有任何法医病理学证据表明福尔比格家的孩子们是被蓄意闷死或杀害的。

sentences.en: In my view, it is wrong on the forensic evidence available in this case to conclude that one or more of the Fulbig children are the victims of homicide.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，根据本案现有的法医证据，得出福尔比格家的一个或多个孩子是他杀受害者的结论是错误的。

sentences.en: There is no merit in forcing certainty where uncertainty exists.
sentences.zh: 在存在不确定性的地方强求确定性是毫无意义的。

sentences.en: If the convictions in this case are to stand, I want to clearly state there is no pathological or medical basis for concluding homicide.
sentences.zh: 如果本案的定罪维持不变，我想明确指出，没有任何病理学或医学依据来得出他杀的结论。

sentences.en: The findings are completely compatible with natural causes.
sentences.zh: 这些发现与自然死亡完全吻合。

sentences.en: In 2013, the Newcastle Legal Centre officially took on Kathleen's case pro bono and announced that they would be seeking an inquiry into her conviction.
sentences.zh: 2013年，纽卡斯尔法律中心正式无偿接手了凯瑟琳的案件，并宣布将寻求对她的定罪进行调查。

sentences.en: In addition to Cordner's report, they had Kathleen's diary entries studied by a clinical psychologist who was scathing of the prosecution's interpretation of them
sentences.zh: 除了科德纳的报告外，他们还请了一位临床心理学家研究凯瑟琳的日记，该心理学家对检方将日记解读为

sentences.en: as being confessions to the alleged crimes.
sentences.zh: 对所谓罪行的供述表示了严厉批评。

sentences.en: Just like Dr Emma Cunliffe had suggested, the psychologist believed the diary entries proved that Kathleen was no different from many other postpartum mothers
sentences.zh: 正如艾玛·坎利夫博士所建议的那样，这位心理学家认为日记内容证明凯瑟琳与许多其他产后母亲并无不同，

sentences.en: in that she felt isolated and sometimes depressed and worried about her marriage and physical appearance following childbirth.
sentences.zh: 因为她在分娩后感到孤独，有时会抑郁，并为自己的婚姻和外貌感到担忧。

sentences.en: Kathleen's diary entries suggested to the psychologist that she interpreted her feelings of stress, irritability and exhaustion as evidence of poor mothering.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的日记向心理学家表明，她将自己感到的压力、易怒和疲惫解读为育儿不当的证据。

sentences.en: She then equated her reaction to motherhood as the reason that her children had died.
sentences.zh: 然后，她将自己对为人母的反应等同于孩子死亡的原因。

sentences.en: The psychologist found it significant that Kathleen had never once mentioned having harmed any of the children or even wanting to harm them.
sentences.zh: 心理学家发现一个重要事实，即凯瑟琳从未提及伤害过任何孩子，甚至从未有过伤害他们的念头。

sentences.en: Why hold this information back in a diary that she didn't expect anyone else to ever read?
sentences.zh: 为什么要在她从未指望任何人阅读的日记中隐瞒这些信息呢？

sentences.en: The psychologist concluded that the prosecution using the diaries as evidence was misleading and unsupported by psychological literature on maternal adjustment.
sentences.zh: 心理学家得出结论，检方将日记作为证据是误导性的，且缺乏关于产后心理调整的心理学文献支持。

sentences.en: Despite everything that had emerged from Sally Clark's appeal in the UK,
sentences.zh: 尽管英国萨莉·克拉克上诉案中出现了一切情况，

sentences.en: Kathleen's defence team had not called any experts to testify that theories such as Meadows Law had been discredited.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的辩护团队并没有传唤任何专家来证明像“梅多斯法则”这样的理论已被推翻。

sentences.en: Kathleen's new legal team had the case reviewed by a British professor of mathematics who'd provided evidence for the Clark case.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的新法律团队请了一位曾为克拉克案提供证据的英国数学教授对案件进行了审查。

sentences.en: He called Meadows Law complete nonsense and concluded that the jury in Kathleen's case had been misled by expert statements about the rarity of multiple SIDS in a single family.
sentences.zh: 他称“梅多斯法则”完全是无稽之谈，并得出结论：凯瑟琳案的陪审团被关于单一家庭中多次发生婴儿猝死综合征概率的专家陈述误导了。

sentences.en: While multiple SIDS cases were indeed rare, the professor pointed out that statistically speaking, there were far more instances of multiple SIDS
sentences.zh: 虽然多次发生婴儿猝死综合征的情况确实罕见，但这位教授指出，从统计学上讲，多次发生婴儿猝死综合征的实例远比

sentences.en: than there were of multiple infant murders.
sentences.zh: 多次发生婴儿谋杀案的实例要多得多。

sentences.en: With such a large number of women giving birth each week, he concluded it was inevitable that there would be instances of multiple unexplained deaths in the one family.
sentences.zh: 考虑到每周有如此多的女性分娩，他得出结论，在同一个家庭中出现多次无法解释的死亡是不可避免的。

sentences.en: A long-running study in the UK had actually shown that families who had lost one child to SIDS had an increased chance of losing a second baby to SIDS.
sentences.zh: 英国一项长期研究实际上表明，失去过一个死于婴儿猝死综合征孩子的家庭，失去第二个婴儿的几率会增加。

sentences.en: With the jury in Kathleen's case being told there were no recorded instances of three or more SIDS in the one family, the professor said this had essentially left the jury
sentences.zh: 由于凯瑟琳案的陪审团被告知没有记录显示同一家庭中发生过三次或三次以上婴儿猝死综合征，教授表示这实际上让陪审团

sentences.en: incorrectly believing that homicide was the only explanation for the deaths of the Fulbig children.
sentences.zh: 错误地认为他杀是福尔比格家孩子死亡的唯一解释。

sentences.en: With all of this new evidence coming to light, in May 2015,
sentences.zh: 随着所有这些新证据的浮出水面，2015年5月，

sentences.en: Kathleen's legal team announced that they had signed a petition calling for her convictions to be reviewed by the New South Wales
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的法律团队宣布，他们已经签署了一份请愿书，呼吁新南威尔士州

sentences.en: Attorney General.
sentences.zh: 总检察长对她的定罪进行审查。

sentences.en: For Kathleen Fulbig, this news couldn't have been more welcome.
sentences.zh: 对于凯瑟琳·福尔比格来说，这个消息再受欢迎不过了。

sentences.en: By this point, she had served
sentences.zh: 到此时，她已经服刑了

sentences.en: 12 years of her sentence, two of them in solitude, and she'd never wavered from her position that she was innocent.
sentences.zh: 12年，其中两年是在单独监禁中度过的，她从未动摇过自己无罪的立场。

sentences.en: The truth was that like many other new mothers,
sentences.zh: 事实是，像许多其他新手母亲一样，

sentences.en: Kathleen had struggled with the identity shift that comes with being a parent.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳一直在努力适应为人父母带来的身份转变。

sentences.en: While she had loved Craig deeply in the early years of their marriage, she grew to resent the fact that the overnight parenting duties always fell to her.
sentences.zh: 虽然她在婚姻初期深爱着克雷格，但她逐渐开始怨恨夜间育儿的责任总是落在她一个人身上。

sentences.en: Craig was and always had been an incredibly deep sleeper.
sentences.zh: 克雷格一直是一个睡得非常沉的人。

sentences.en: Once his head hit the pillow, he was out for the count until morning and he joked that a bomb could go off without waking him.
sentences.zh: 一旦他的头碰到枕头，他就会一直睡到天亮，他开玩笑说就算炸弹爆炸也吵不醒他。

sentences.en: None of the baby's cries ever woke him, leaving Kathleen to deal with the nights alone.
sentences.zh: 婴儿的哭声从未吵醒过他，这让凯瑟琳不得不独自应对夜晚。

sentences.en: As someone who had always been a big sleeper herself and didn't like to stay up late, the lack of sleep or time to herself really took its toll on Kathleen.
sentences.zh: 作为一个一直很能睡且不喜欢熬夜的人，睡眠不足或没有个人时间确实让凯瑟琳不堪重负。

sentences.en: Because of this, establishing predictable routines with each of the children's bedtimes was important to her.
sentences.zh: 因此，为每个孩子建立可预测的就寝习惯对她来说很重要。

sentences.en: She found it frustrating that Craig didn't seem to take this seriously and instead interpreted her as being somewhat neurotic and overly controlling.
sentences.zh: 她感到沮丧的是，克雷格似乎并不把这当回事，反而认为她有些神经质且控制欲过强。

sentences.en: It wasn't just the lack of sleep that bothered Kathleen.
sentences.zh: 困扰凯瑟琳的不仅仅是睡眠不足。

sentences.en: Shortly after Patrick died, she found Craig in what looked like a romantic embrace with one of her friends.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克去世后不久，她发现克雷格似乎正与她的一个朋友深情拥抱。

sentences.en: Years later, after Sarah was born, she suspected that Craig might be interested in other women.
sentences.zh: 多年后，在莎拉出生后，她怀疑克雷格可能对其他女性感兴趣。

sentences.en: Craig had also made some comments about Kathleen's weight gain over the years, which contributed to her own self-consciousness.
sentences.zh: 克雷格还对凯瑟琳多年来的体重增加发表了一些评论，这加剧了她的自我意识。

sentences.en: It was around this time that their relationship reached rock bottom, with Kathleen feeling severely insecure, unattractive, and rejected by Craig.
sentences.zh: 就在这段时间，他们的关系降到了冰点，凯瑟琳感到极度缺乏安全感、没有吸引力，并被克雷格拒绝。

sentences.en: While she first started exercising as a means to lose weight, she grew to love the other benefits that exercise gave her.
sentences.zh: 虽然她最初开始锻炼是为了减肥，但她逐渐爱上了锻炼带来的其他好处。

sentences.en: Going to the gym wasn't the vain obsession that the prosecution had depicted, but a way to keep her mental health in check.
sentences.zh: 去健身房并不是检方所描述的那种虚荣的痴迷，而是她保持心理健康的一种方式。

sentences.en: It had always bothered Kathleen that such a big deal was made about her going back to the gym just days after Laura died.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳一直很介意人们对她在劳拉去世几天后就回到健身房这件事大做文章。

sentences.en: After all,
sentences.zh: 毕竟，

sentences.en: Craig had gone back to work at the same time and nobody had batted an eye at that.
sentences.zh: 克雷格在同一时间也回去工作了，没人对此感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Then there was the scrutiny about her perceived lack of emotion following her children's deaths.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有关于她在孩子去世后表现出缺乏情感的审查。

sentences.en: When Kathleen was a child, her foster mother often reacted negatively any time Kathleen was in a bad mood.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳小时候，每当她心情不好时，她的养母经常会做出负面反应。

sentences.en: She therefore grew up believing that she had to keep any negative emotions in check because she didn't want to inflict them on other people.
sentences.zh: 因此，她在成长过程中认为自己必须控制住任何负面情绪，因为她不想把这些情绪强加给别人。

sentences.en: In reality, the deaths of all four of her children had devastated Kathleen.
sentences.zh: 实际上，四个孩子的相继离世让凯瑟琳悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: She had simply chosen not to wallow in her grief and to do her best to get on with life.
sentences.zh: 她只是选择不沉溺于悲伤，并尽最大努力继续生活。

sentences.en: After she was suspected of killing her children, she detached herself from the situation, a coping mechanism she'd learned when she entered the foster system as a three-year-old.
sentences.zh: 在被怀疑杀害自己的孩子后，她将自己与现实隔离开来，这是一种她从三岁进入寄养系统时就学会的应对机制。

sentences.en: It also helped her survive in prison where she was the target of hatred and violence from other inmates.
sentences.zh: 这也帮助她在监狱中生存下来，在那里她成为了其他囚犯仇恨和暴力的目标。

sentences.en: The diaries were a way for Kathleen to unload her darkest feelings without burdening anyone else.
sentences.zh: 日记是凯瑟琳宣泄内心最阴暗情绪而不给他人增加负担的一种方式。

sentences.en: She didn't use them to record feelings of joy or contentment, even though these were emotions she experienced regularly.
sentences.zh: 她并没有用日记来记录快乐或满足的感觉，尽管这些也是她经常体验到的情绪。

sentences.en: Assuming that no one else would ever read them, she had just jotted her thoughts down as they poured out of her without taking time It was a way to purge her negative emotions
sentences.zh: 假设没有人会读到这些日记，她只是随手写下涌上心头的想法，没有花时间去修饰。这是一种宣泄负面情绪的方式，

sentences.en: as well as try and figure out what was going on in her life.
sentences.zh: 同时也试图弄清楚她生活中到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: For example, the comment that Sarah had left, with a bit of help, was a reference to God or some kind of higher power having already taken her two sons.
sentences.zh: 例如，关于莎拉“离开”的评论，在某种程度上是指上帝或某种更高力量已经带走了她的两个儿子。

sentences.en: Kathleen believed in karma and fate and at the time of writing the diaries, she thought it was possible that her deceased children could communicate with one another.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳相信因果报应和命运，在写日记时，她认为她去世的孩子们之间可能能够交流。

sentences.en: When she wrote that she couldn't have handled another child like Sarah and that Laura had saved her life by being different, she was simply reflecting on this belief.
sentences.zh: 当她写道她无法再应付像莎拉这样的孩子，而劳拉因为与众不同而救了她的命时，她只是在反思这种信念。

sentences.en: Her entry about wanting Sarah to shut up and one day she did wasn't an admission of guilt but merely an observation.
sentences.zh: 她关于希望莎拉闭嘴而有一天她真的闭嘴了的记录，并不是认罪，而仅仅是一种观察。

sentences.en: As for the comment that she was most scared about being left alone with the baby, this wasn't because she presented a threat to them, it was because she was petrified
sentences.zh: 至于她最害怕独自与婴儿待在一起的评论，这并不是因为她对他们构成了威胁，而是因为她被

sentences.en: of finding them dead.
sentences.zh: 发现他们死亡的恐惧所笼罩。

sentences.en: Kathleen was adamant that if she had killed the children, there would be no room for misinterpretation as she would have used her diaries to try and figure out why she'd done
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳坚称，如果她杀害了这些孩子，就不会有任何误解的空间，因为她会利用日记来试图弄清楚她为什么要

sentences.en: such a thing.
sentences.zh: 做这种事。

sentences.en: If she was guilty, she would have either confessed or taken her own life.
sentences.zh: 如果她真的有罪，她要么会坦白，要么会结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: Given how young the babies had been when they died,
sentences.zh: 鉴于孩子们去世时还那么小，

sentences.en: Kathleen had very little to remember them by.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳几乎没有什么关于他们的记忆。

sentences.en: The longer she spent in prison, the more distant those memories became.
sentences.zh: 她在监狱里待的时间越长，那些记忆就变得越模糊。

sentences.en: She did what she could to maintain her sanity while serving her sentence, keeping her head down to avoid poor treatment from other inmates and leaning on the friendships
sentences.zh: 她在服刑期间尽其所能保持理智，保持低调以避免受到其他囚犯的虐待，并依靠她

sentences.en: she still had in the outside world.
sentences.zh: 在外界仍然拥有的友谊。

sentences.en: Kathleen welcomed anyone who wanted to help her case and with the petition to the Attorney General being filed, she was hopeful that her side of the story
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳欢迎任何愿意帮助她案件的人，随着向总检察长提交请愿书，她满怀希望地认为她的故事

sentences.en: would finally be believed.
sentences.zh: 最终会被相信。

sentences.en: But the petition languished for years as Kathleen and her legal team waited with bated breath for news.
sentences.zh: 但请愿书被搁置了多年，凯瑟琳和她的法律团队屏息以待消息。

sentences.en: With nothing appearing to be happening, in August 2018, the case was covered for the second time by ABC's Australian Story.
sentences.zh: 由于似乎没有任何进展，2018年8月，ABC的《澳大利亚故事》节目第二次报道了此案。

sentences.en: Not only did the segment present expert evidence suggesting that Kathleen had been wrongfully convicted, it also featured interviews with Kathleen by way of phone calls from prison
sentences.zh: 该节目不仅提出了表明凯瑟琳被错误定罪的专家证据，还通过监狱电话采访了凯瑟琳，

sentences.en: with her strongest supporter, a childhood friend named Tracy Chapman.
sentences.zh: 以及她最坚定的支持者，一位名叫特蕾西·查普曼的童年好友。

sentences.en: It was the closest thing
sentences.zh: 这是凯瑟琳

sentences.en: Kathleen had ever made to a public appearance and gave her the chance to explain her side of the story for the first time.
sentences.zh: 有史以来最接近公开露面的一次，让她有机会第一次解释自己的故事。

sentences.en: Within days of the episode airing, the NSW Attorney General held a press conference to announce that a full inquiry would be held into Kathleen Fulbig's convictions.
sentences.zh: 节目播出几天后，新南威尔士州总检察长召开新闻发布会，宣布将对凯瑟琳·福尔比格的定罪进行全面调查。

sentences.en: While this was excellent news for Kathleen and her supporters, there were even bigger things brewing.
sentences.zh: 虽然这对凯瑟琳和她的支持者来说是个极好的消息，但还有更大的事情在酝酿之中。

sentences.en: There had always been questions about whether the Fulbig children had a genetic mutation that could explain their deaths and recent advancements in medical technology
